correctness.rationale: For each n>=1, the Buck–Elder–Figueroa–Harris–Harry–Simpson type-B partition bijection maps a distinguished zero block with z extra labels to a word of (d,p)=(0,1) when z=0, otherwise (1,z), giving Z=u+t(exp(ux)-1). A nonzero block pair of s absolute labels, normalized with its smallest absolute label positive, has q negative and s-q positive entries; its word f(N)g(P) has (d,p)=(0,1) for s=1, and for s>=2 the mutually exhaustive classes q=0, q=s-1 and 1<=q<=s-2 contribute t*u^(s-1), t*u^s and binom(s-1,q)*t^2*u^(s-1), respectively. Counting signs gives the factor 2^(s-1)-2. The canonical order of blocks makes every interblock adjacency a strict ascent; thus no boundary plateau/descent and the labeled SET exponential formula proves Z*exp(W) over Z[t,u][[x]] for all n. The x^(n-1)/(n-1)! index shift and 2n-1 internal comparisons are correct; n=1 gives H1=u. Independent exhaustive insertion enumeration of all (2n-1)!! Stirling permutations for each 1<=n<=8, filtered by weak-run starts, matched the independently derived signed-block polynomial recurrence in every (d,p) cell (totals 1,2,6,24,116,648,4088,28640); at n=4 the five coefficients match RESULT.md. At u=1 algebra yields exactly Shankar Corollary 10; at t=u=1 the total EGF is exp(x+(e^(2x)-1)/2). The infinite proof comes from the bijection plus local weights, not finite checks.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge originality of the all-order simultaneous internal-descent/internal-plateau enumerator on flattened 2-Stirling permutations. Shankar 2023 gives only the u=1 descent marginal and expressly asks in Section 7 item 4 for the joint ascent/plateau distribution. Buck et al. give the requisite bijection but not the joint marked species. Ma–Ma–Yeh 2019 concerns all Stirling permutations, Ma–Liu–Yeh–Yeh 2025 concerns the distinct singleton-minimum class; Baril–Ramírez 2026 concerns ordinary distinct-letter flattened permutations. Actual Resultary queries found no dominating same-object result, but search noncoverage does not establish priority. The proof refines prior block decomposition with a separate plateau marking; the established bijection, totals, and descent marginal are excluded from the novelty claim.
residual_risks: A relevant later paper, unindexed thesis, appendix, or specialization of a broader theorem might already state the same joint polynomial.

The proof and EGF architecture use the previously published type-B block bijection and Shankar’s descent-weighted species; novelty is solely the separate plateau refinement, with correspondingly bounded significance.

The paper-sized k>2 extension is not proved or required; significance is narrow because the base bijection and univariate EGF are prior art.
